design: RCT, pre-registered NCT05131451, stratified block randomization
population: Youth 8-21y with T1D/T2D, single academic pediatric diabetes center
intervention_or_exposure: Autonomous AI diabetic eye exam at point of care
comparator: Scripted referral to eye care provider + education
outcome: [Process] diabetic eye exam completion within 6 months; secondary follow-through to eye care provider after DED-positive
effect_with_CI: Completion 81/81 (100%; 95%CI 95.5-100) vs 18/82 (22%; 14.2-32.4) p<0.001; AI-positive follow-through 16/25 (64%; 43-81) vs control 18 completed
limitations: Exam done by the intervention itself so completion partly by design; single center youth; follow-through denominators differ (25 AI-positive vs 82 all control); no vision/blindness endpoint; 9/25 AI-positive not followed

design: Prospective diagnostic accuracy pivotal study vs reading center (FPRC)
population: Adults with diabetes, no prior DR history, 10 US primary care sites
comparator: Wisconsin FPRC widefield stereo photos + OCT reference
effect_with_CI: Sensitivity 87.2% (81.8-91.2); specificity 90.7% (88.3-92.7); imageability 96.1% (94.6-97.3)
limitations: 900 is enrollment not analysis denominator; no downstream-outcome (vision) endpoint; 73 non-analyzable differed in lens status/age

design: RCT, 8 weeks, 4 Stanford primary care clinics
population: Adults with T2D starting/adjusting basal insulin
intervention_or_exposure: Voice-based conversational AI (VBAI; rules-based deterministic titration protocol chosen by clinician)
outcome: [Intermediate/behavioral] time to optimal insulin dose; insulin adherence (self-logged); mean FBG
effect_with_CI: Median 15 days (IQR 6-27) vs >56 days; adherence 82.9% vs 50.2% (diff 32.7%, 95%CI 8.0-57.4, p=.01)
limitations: Small; 7 randomized not analyzed; adherence self-reported and logs incomplete in control; HbA1c not primary; AI = voice front end to rules; registration number not located in parsed text (UNRESOLVED)

design: Multicenter open RCT, noninferiority (margin -6 pp), 5 days
population: Hospitalized adults with T2D, 3 Chinese centers; excluded severe organ disease/psychiatric
n: 149 randomized (75 vs 74); 13 discontinued; per-protocol 68 per group
intervention_or_exposure: iNCDSS (ML-based insulin titration CDSS, physician reviews daily)
effect_with_CI: TIR 76.4% vs 73.6%; diff 2.7 pp (95%CI -2.7 to 8.0) meets NI margin -6
limitations: Inpatient 5 days; supervised by physicians; secondary outcomes exploratory; trial registration number not located in parsed text (UNRESOLVED); comparator = expert not usual care

design: Retrospective expert evaluation of GPT-4 outputs (zero-shot), not a trial
population: Complex T2D clinic notes, UCSF tertiary diabetes
n: 243 notes; 230 sampled into two 115-note sets; 5 diabetologist raters
intervention_or_exposure: GPT-4 extracts goals, judges plan ideal-or-not, gives reasoning
outcome: [Model output quality] goal discernment; plan suitability; reasoning helpfulness; hallucination taxonomy
effect_with_CI: Plan assessment (115 notes): accuracy 64%, precision 80%, recall 73%, specificity 35%; 40% of reasoning helpful; hallucination: decontextualized 29/115 (25%), nonfactual 7/115 (6%), self-conflicting 1/115 (1%)
limitations: No patient outcomes; single tertiary center; zero-shot GPT-4 only; 'helpful' is expert opinion

design: Pragmatic 3-arm RCT, NCT06792890 (registered after start per authors)
population: 238 outpatient physicians, 14 specialties, single US academic institution, 4 Nov 2024-3 Jan 2025
intervention_or_exposure: Ambient AI scribe (DAX Copilot or Nabla)
outcome: [Workflow] change in log time-in-note; secondary burnout surveys
limitations: Single site, English only, 2 months; scribe used in 29.5-33.5% of visits; ~15% never used; secondary endpoints not hypothesis-tested; not diabetes-specific; relative % not pp

design: Pragmatic cluster-randomized trial (clinical officer clusters), PACTR202502499779176
population: Penda Health 16 urban primary care facilities Nairobi/Kiambu; all-comer primary care
n: 9,691 enrolled; 9,347 analyzed (4,693 LLM vs 4,654 control); 103 clinical officers
effect_with_CI: Failure 102/4,693 (2.2%) vs 94/4,654 (2.0%); aOR 0.77 (0.55-1.08) p=.13 (adjusted for facility and clinical officer)
limitations: Source-internal inconsistency: raw rates favor control while aOR<1; powered for 50% relative reduction (underpowered for modest effect); contamination within facility; not diabetes

design: Development/formative evaluation, offline
population: West China Hospital outpatient diabetes EHR (Jan-Feb 2022), deidentified, single institution
n: 300 recommendations rated by 5 endocrinologists (BLEU/ROUGE on test set)
outcome: [Text similarity + expert Likert] BLEU-4, ROUGE, 6-dimension rating
effect_with_CI: GLM4-9B BLEU-4 67.93 (SD 2.74); ROUGE-1 44.30; ROUGE-L 37.67
limitations: No prospective validation (authors); BLEU against historical physician orders; single institution; small models

design: Vignette-based source-masked multirater comparative evaluation (DECIDE-AI-aligned reporting)
population: 12 synthetic CGM cases; 6 UK senior diabetes clinicians
intervention_or_exposure: Retrieval-grounded LLM conversational agent for CGM counseling
outcome: [Communication quality, expert-rated] 6 Likert dimensions + safety flags
effect_with_CI: CA 4.37 (SD 0.57) vs clinician 3.58 (SD 0.90); diff 0.782 (95%CI 0.692-0.872); major safety concerns 3 (0.7%) in each
limitations: Synthetic vignettes; CA responses longer; small rater panel; no patient outcomes; not for autonomous decisions (authors)

design: Development/implementation, pre-post log comparison (no control)

intervention_or_exposure: LLM-generated handover drafts in in-house NIS
effect_with_CI: Mean 3.45-4.32 min -> 1.17-2.54 min; estimated 474-981 h/month saved
limitations: Pre-post, 1-month baseline, estimated (not measured) hours; nursing not diabetes

design: Clinic-randomized trial, Minnesota, Oct 2006-May 2007

limitations: Abstract only in PMC subset; system name 'Diabetes Wizard' not in abstract; traditional CDS not AI

design: IPD meta-analysis external validation of KFRE
population: 31 cohorts, CKD G3-G5, >30 countries
comparator: Pooled refit equations; regional calibration factor
effect_with_CI: C 0.90 (0.89-0.92) at 2y; 0.88 (0.86-0.90) at 5y; non-North America calibration factor lowers baseline risk by 32.9% (2y) and 16.5% (5y)
limitations: eGFR by CKD-EPI 2009; competing mortality not modeled; supplement coefficients not in parsed text
claim_verified: grep-verified (calibration factors reconcile arithmetically with S0 0.9750->0.9832, 0.9240->0.9365)

design: Observational validation, UK Biobank and SCREAM
population: CKD with/without multimorbidity (UKB n=24,489; SCREAM n=42,902)
intervention_or_exposure: 4-variable KFRE with eGFRcr/cys; updated competing-risk model
effect_with_CI: AUC>=0.86 all; O/E 1.75 at 5y UKB multimorbid (underestimation) vs 1.05 SCREAM; updated model O/E 0.98
limitations: Calibration varies by setting; cystatin C no improvement

design: Multicohort evaluation (59 cohorts) of KFRE with CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR
